statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-40164: jq hashed JSON object keys with MurmurHash3 under a fixed, public seed (0x432A9843), so a crafted object of about 100 KB whose keys all collide turns lookups into O(n) work and pins the CPU (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-wwj8-gxm6-jc29). Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/0c7d133c3c7e37c00b6d46b658a02244fdd3c784, 'Randomize hash seed to mitigate hash collision DoS attacks', which names this CVE and seeds the hash once per process from arc4random, getentropy or /dev/urandom; it is first released in jq 1.8.2. Checked libjq.so.1.0.4 in the jq package (which /usr/bin/jq links) and libjq.a in jq-dev for every jq build published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 1.8.1-r0, 1.8.1_git20260429-r1, 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 and 1.8.2_git20261021-r2, x86_64 and aarch64. Both 1.8.2 builds call getentropy for the seed, the musl path of the fix; the two 1.8.1 builds do not, and on x86_64 they still embed the fixed seed constant. The range ends at 1.8.2_git20260622-r1.

CVE-2026-40164: jq hashed JSON object keys with MurmurHash3 under a fixed, public seed (0x432A9843), so a crafted object of about 100 KB whose keys all collide turns lookups into O(n) work and pins the CPU (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-wwj8-gxm6-jc29). Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/0c7d133c3c7e37c00b6d46b658a02244fdd3c784, which names this CVE and seeds the hash once per process from a random source; it is first released in jq 1.8.2. Debian backported it to trixie in 1.7.1-6+deb13u2, whose changelog lists CVE-2026-40164 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-40164). Checked libjq.so.1.0.4 in libjq1 for every jq build published in the DHI Debian repository, amd64 and arm64. The DHI rebuilds of Debian 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 and the DHI build of jq 1.8.2-1 call arc4random for the seed, which is the fix; the 1.7.1 build from before Debian's +deb13u2 update does not. An arm64-only build versioned 1.8.1-5, made from an unreleased Debian 1.8.1-5 changelog entry that predates Debian's fix, does not carry it either: its libjq still embeds the fixed seed constant and never calls arc4random, getentropy or /dev/urandom. Because 1.8.1-5 sorts above the 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 rebuilds, the range has two affected spans: below the first DHI rebuild of 1.7.1-6+deb13u2, and from 1.8.1-5 to below the DHI build of 1.8.2-1.
